# Docs-only patterns. The only reader is scripts/ci/docs-only.mjs.
# A change is docs-only when every file matches an include and no exclude.
# An empty change is not docs-only (the script, not this file, decides that).

+ README.md
+ AGENTS.md
+ CHANGELOG.md
+ LICENSE

- .github/**
- scripts/**
